reason: Rule requirements.md:19 'never exceed 20%' gives an observable bound a tester can assert (result <= 20%).
unit/session.test.ts:18 and :24 are the only expiry tests and both are it.skip.
No test targets quote-page ease of use; e2e/quote.spec.ts only checks premiums.
integration/payment.test.ts calls PaymentService.charge with keys but never repeats a key, so the idempotent behaviour is untouched though the code is exercised.
src/routes/admin.ts:8,12 use requireLogin only, no admin role check or 403.
integration/payment-sim.test.ts:3 tests PaymentSimulator, not GatewayAdapter.charge (src/payment/gateway-adapter.ts:8).
docs/requirements.md:13 'where possible' is open to retrying only transient failures or every decline.
DEC-05 (docs/design.md:29) answers the exhausted-retries case (PAYMENT_UNAVAILABLE), so the documents do not leave it unanswered.
DEC-07 (docs/design.md:39) states the CRM-failure outcome, so the case is answered in the documents.
DEC-07 lets the purchase complete when the CRM update fails, which arguably departs from REQ-06's 'shall send', but it can be read as the failure path of the same rule.
REQ-08 'never exceed 20%' already bounds combined discounts; the DEC-11 25% clash is a consistency matter, not a missing case.
docs/requirements.md:27 gives no base, term or date for 'pro rata', so an expected refund cannot be computed from the text.
docs/requirements.md:15 joins email, CRM update and event log in one rule.
docs/design.md:33 says nothing about a failed write or read of the stored result.
DEC-07 (docs/design.md:39) accepts a CRM failure while REQ-06 says the update shall be sent; it records the outcome but names no trade-off.
docs/design.md:20 is silent on a failed write or failed nightly delete of the quotes table.
docs/design.md:43 describes an outside email send with no timeout or failure behaviour.
The only expiry assertions (unit/session.test.ts:20,26) are skipped; running tests assert role and id uniqueness only.
e2e/quote.spec.ts asserts premium text only; nothing asserts usability.
e2e specs run only in nightly.yml; pr.yml and vitest.config.ts include only unit and component.
src/payment/gateway-adapter.ts:10 calls fetch with no timeout although config/payment.json has timeoutMs.
No unit, component, integration or e2e test references discounts or applyDiscount (src/pricing/discount.ts).
The 100 in src/pricing/round.ts:3 is a cents scale factor, not a stated limit; unit/rounding.test.ts covers the half-up edge (10.005/10.004).
integration/payment.test.ts:9 asserts one charge returns ok; no test sends the same key twice or counts gateway calls.
integration/payment.test.ts is excluded from PR runs (vitest.config.ts include) and runs only in nightly.yml:12.
The 30-day date rule (src/quote/repo.ts isPastRetention) has no unit test; it is covered only by integration (nightly) and e2e.
No test or implementation relates to CDN caching of quote pages.
integration/eligibility.test.ts:9-16 tests the postcode check reading config/areas.csv (src/eligibility.ts:3,7); the unread index has no behaviour to test.
